title: Mushroom Child Portrait
description: A surreal portrait of a young boy with pale skin and dark hair, wearing a large fly agaric mushroom as a hat. A vibrant blue liquid splashes from the right side of his head while a cartoon teddy bear floats in the upper left against a dark, moody background with colorful flowers and geometric shapes.
